adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the `deleteEvent` fallback was changed to:

```ts
const calendarId = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is not provided (the fallback path), it searches for a destination calendar whose `externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `undefined`/`null`), which will never match real calendar IDs. This makes the fallback effectively dead and results in `calendarId` being `undefined`, so the subsequent delete call will fall back to the default (the file defines `defaultCalendarId = "primary"` right above), meaning deletions will target `primary` even when the event was created on a non-primary destination calendar. That is a correctness issue consistent with the finding.
